comments.body: same here. Had to revert to my build from 1/30

Hi Adrian,
first impression: oh God, i lost all readings (display: 0.00, disappeared graph).
But then I got xDrip+ readings and the grah is rebuilt reading by reading.
If the lost of readings history is intended, than the fix is o.k.
Once more: THANK YOU!

@swissalpine the loss of history is a side effect of switching to a modern database system and unrelated. (parallel development).
Thanks for testing.
